---
name: Feedback from using an AI assistant with Choupo
about: You asked an AI assistant (ChatGPT, Claude, ...) to design or run a case with Choupo, and something was wrong, missing or unclear
title: "[assistant] "
labels: assistant-feedback
---

You may write in Portuguese or English.  One report per problem.

**What did you ask the assistant to do?** (the problem, in your own words)

**Which assistant and which documents did it read?** (for example the brief at
https://www.choupo.org/llm/brief.md and which packs)

**What went wrong?** Tick what applies:
- [ ] the case did not load or Choupo refused it (paste the COMPLETE message)
- [ ] the case ran but a number looks wrong (which one, and what you expected)
- [ ] the assistant invented a key, a unit type or a component name
- [ ] the layout or the drawing is wrong or unclear
- [ ] a document says something that is not true of Choupo
- [ ] something is missing that your project needs

**The smallest case that shows it**, when you can share it (a folder or a
.zip attached).  Do not attach papers, vendor data sheets or confidential files;
a citation or a public link is better.

**Where did you expect to see the answer?** (a page, a table, a drawing)

Reports are advice to the maintainer: sending one does not create authorship or
guarantee that something is implemented (see CONTRIBUTING.md).  A failure you
report may become a test problem for the assistant documents.
